institution: University of Colorado Denver/Anschutz Medical Campus

app_fee.value: Application fee is $75 USD for international applicants ($50 for domestic applicants).

fee_waiver.value: The $75 application fee is automatically waived for applicants required to undergo ECE/WES external credential evaluations (required for CU Anschutz international applicants, though ECE/WES itself charges $163–$208), and fee waivers are also available for Fulbright recipients, applicants with qualifying disabilities, or recruitment event attendees.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fees are automatically waived for: Veteran or military. Applicants required to undergo external credential evaluations.

also.quote: Graduate students opting to do an ECE or WES evaluation will not be charged the $75 application fee.
Fulbright Scholarship recipients. An individual with a disability that substantially limits one or more major life activities.

gre_general.value: GRE requirements are set by individual programs; all four STEM health-science/biology PhD programs listed here do not require GRE scores.

also.quote: Some graduate programs require standardized test scores (such as GRE or GMAT) for admission.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score of 79 overall (Reading 8, Listening 7, Speaking 18, Writing 16); for tests taken on or after Jan 21, 2026 (1–6 scale), minimum 4 overall (Reading 3, Listening 2.5, Speaking 3.5, Writing 3.5).
toefl_min.quote: Test TOEFL iBT IELTS Academic PTE Academic Duolingo English Test Overall Score 79 6.5 58 105 Subscores - Reading 8 5.5 42 Literacy: 85 - Listening 7 5.5 42 Conversation: 85 - Speaking 18 5.5 42 Comprehension: 85 - Writing 16 5.5 42 Production: 85

also.quote: *Scores in the 1–6 scale apply only to TOEFL iBT tests taken on or after January 21, 2026.

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic score of 6.5 overall (5.5 minimum in Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing).

english_waiver.value: India is not on the exempt country list, and Medium-of-Instruction letters (LOIs) are not accepted; Indian applicants without a US or exempt-country degree must submit English test scores.
english_waiver.quote: CU Denver does not accept Letters of Instruction (LOIs) issued by schools as proof of English language proficiency. Applicants must provide official test scores or other approved documentation.

also.quote: International applicants holding citizenship from the following countries do not need to prove their English language proficiency for admission to CU Denver.

notes: Health-science scope (CU Anschutz Medical Campus & CU Denver): research covers biomed, neuro, bme, and biology PhDs. International CU Anschutz applicants must provide a course-by-course ECE or WES evaluation.
